ارتجوا (form VIII)
# اِرْتَجَوْا (irtajaw) /ir.ta.d͡ʒaw/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِرْتَجَى (irtajā)
# اُرْتُجُوا (urtujū) /ur.tu.d͡ʒuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِرْتَجَى (irtajā)
# اِرْتَجُوا (irtajū) /ir.ta.d͡ʒuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِرْتَجَى (irtajā)
